title: Update organ donation details
summary: This page provides options for updating your organ donation details, either online through myGov or by completing a PDF form.
intro:
If you have a myGov account linked to Medicare, an online option is available to:

If you cannot update your donation details through myGov follow the instructions to complete the form Australian Organ Donor Register – PDF.

You will need your Medicare details to complete the PDF form.
what_you_need: Medicare details (if using the PDF form)

more_info.text: You cannot update your organ and tissue donation decision through your NSW Driver Licence.

faqs.q: How can I update my organ donation details?
faqs.a: If you have a myGov account linked to Medicare, you can update your details online through myGov. Alternatively, you can complete the Australian Organ Donor Register PDF form.

faqs.q: Do I need any details to update my donation status?
faqs.a: If you complete the PDF form, you will need your Medicare details.
